title: The Most Toxic Things Christians Say to People Who Leave

top_liked.author: @Satans_lil_helper
top_liked.text:
The most potent weapon of the oppressor is the mind of the oppressed.

-Steven Biko

top_liked.author: @somersetcace1
top_liked.text: This is a clear-eyed breakdown of how belief systems protect themselves when questioned. Naming the fallacies doesn’t villainize believers, it exposes the mechanisms that shut down honest conversation. Well Done Darante' as usual.

top_liked.author: @topgunaudio7983
top_liked.text: So many times I have been asked what hurt has been done to me that made me turn my back on religion - none - I just studied the Bible properly and the hurt done to so many cultures by the religion I left.

top_liked.author: @user-y1k8p
top_liked.text:
"You are going to hell"
"You were never real believer"
"You were never a born-again"
"Your past beliefs still lingers. You still influenced by your past beliefs" (Mormon in my case)

top_liked.author: @abhireddy2552
top_liked.text: Imagine telling someone you were never a real christian to someone who was celibate for the longest time before deconverting because being celibate is the ultimate sign of conviction.

top_liked.author: @Chuck-se5hh
top_liked.text: You are a genius in your channel work.

top_liked.author: @carlo1132
top_liked.text: I'm convinced Tribalism is the biggest problem facing humanity and I do not see a solution.

top_liked.author: @robercoli6136
top_liked.text: I love the comebacks to these! They've all been spoken to me several times

top_liked.author: @roysainsbury4556
top_liked.text: One that was used on me by my mother was "You will be 7 times worse than you were before".  This refers to some passage that says something like "When an evil spirit has left, and later comes back, he will bring 7 of his friends and make you worse" (Matthew 12:43).  Er, did that…

top_liked.author: @firewolf9493
top_liked.text:
The bit about belief systems being filled with logical fallacies is sooooo true!!!
Its upsetting how many of them are used, but because everyone hearing it wants to accept what is being said, its never pointed out!
